# SynthBench

> Open benchmark for synthetic survey respondent quality. SynthBench measures
> how closely AI-generated survey responses match real human opinion
> distributions, reported as the Survey Parity Score (SPS; 1.0 = perfect match)
> across the GlobalOpinionQA, OpinionsQA, and SubPOP datasets.

The live leaderboard is published as a stable, CORS-open JSON API — prefer it
over scraping the HTML site. Every score is recomputed from per-question data
at publish time, with bootstrap confidence intervals.

## Data / API

- [Leaderboard JSON API](https://synthbench.org/data/leaderboard.json): Live rankings for every model/framework/dataset config. Stable semver contract (`api.version`), `generated_at` freshness timestamp, per-row SPS + CIs + cost/latency. `Content-Type: application/json`, `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`.
- [Leaderboard JSON API contract](https://github.com/DataViking-Tech/SynthBench/blob/main/docs/leaderboard-json-api.md): Field-by-field response schema, versioning policy, and consumer guidance.
- [Sitemap](https://synthbench.org/sitemap.xml): All indexable pages.

## Site

- [Overview](https://synthbench.org/): The SynthBench Index (0 = random answers, 100 = a second sample of real people) for every system, with the main results.
- [Leaderboard](https://synthbench.org/leaderboard): Systems ranked by the SynthBench Index and grouped into statistical tiers, with per-dataset scores, score components, cost and holdout checks.
- [Analysis](https://synthbench.org/analysis): Charts of shares vs. order match, raw vs. persona vs. ensemble, per-dataset scores and cost.
- [Groups](https://synthbench.org/groups): Which demographic groups and countries each system matches best and worst, with reference points, 95% intervals, and the effect of naming the group in the prompt.
- [Explore](https://synthbench.org/explore): Every benchmark run grouped by framework and base model; pick two to compare.
- [Compare](https://synthbench.org/compare): Side-by-side diff of two configs or runs, highlighting the questions where they disagree most.
- [Methodology](https://synthbench.org/methodology): SynthBench Index and SPS definitions, metrics, datasets, baselines, run-validity filtering, and anti-gaming protocol.
- [Findings](https://synthbench.org/findings): Main results: raw LLMs vs. random answers, ensembles, prompt templates, temperature, model agreement and subgroup bias.

## Optional

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/DataViking-Tech/SynthBench): Source, submission workflow (`SUBMISSIONS.md`), and the benchmark harness.
- [Submit results](https://synthbench.org/submit): Web upload, CLI, or PR-based leaderboard submission paths.
